name: 风云II（美国版本）
english_description: A wuxia MUD set in the world of Gu Long's novels. It belongs to the “Jinyong Qunxiazhuan”/XKX framework family and shares the same adm/obj/master.lpc with sibling games jyqxc, jyqxc2, jyqxc2013fwq, and xkx2017 — but its game content is entirely different, so it is catalogued here under its own number.
